items.title: Tata Projects bags order for 1,600 MW thermal power plant in Central India
items.rss_summary: EPC major Tata Projects Ltd (TPL) on Monday said it has secured an order to build the complete supporting setup for a 1,600 MW coal-fired power plant in Central India. Under the contract, Tata Projects will be responsible for the design, engineering, manufacture, supply, construction, erection, testing, and commissioning of the project's balance-of-plant systems. These systems encompass critical infrastructure required to support reliable plant operations beyond the boiler-turbine-generator island, the company said in a statement. "Tata Projects Ltd (TPL), one of India's leading Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) companies, has been awarded the complete Balance of Plant (BoP) turnkey package for a 2 x 800 MW ultra-supercritical thermal power project in Central India by a leading integrated power utility," the statement said. The project encompasses the complete BoP scope, including coal and biomass handling systems, fuel and ash management facilities, water intake, ..
